text: ok that fixed it. here is another problem im having. so i have this prefab im working on. and i want to build another room. except i cant seem to get it to grid snap anywhere its like prefabs are on a completely different axis than floors are entirely
resolution: Fixed prefab grid-snap misalignment: prefabs armed in F2 and the iso pane snapped by their ORIGIN (the capture's min piece center — often a wall line) on the 1m substrate, while floors snap module-centered on their own 3m lattice, so a stamped room's floors landed 1-2 tiles off every natively placed floor. Added prefabGridAnchor (game/build/prefabs.ts): the prefab's first floor (else roof) plate center + module size; resolveSnapTarget (editors/build/snap.ts) gains anchorLocal — that point snaps to the module lattice instead of the origin, rotating with the ghost in the same R(+yaw) frame the stamp composes with. Both placement surfaces wired (PlayRoute refreshSnapTarget, IsoAuthor resolveAt). Plateless (walls-only) prefabs keep origin snapping. Tests: snap suite 26/26 + build suite 25/25 incl. new req_0668 cases (flush floors at all four stamp rotations; anchor selection floor>roof>null). TSX-only — hot reload picks it up, no rebuild.
